snippet.title: INDIE GAME ARCS PLAY
snippet.description:
ARCS on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4409620/ARCS/

ARCS is a stage‑based shooter where you assemble your loadout from over 450 types of equipment, build the optimal strategy for each battlefield, and break through waves of incoming enemies.
Terrain layout and object placement can drastically shift the flow of battle, creating entirely different approaches even within the same stage depending on your chosen combination of gear.
Victory comes from pure strategic thinking. When you finally read the battlefield and execute the perfect plan, the tension and rush of achievement hit hard.
You can choose from multiple difficulty levels at the start of each stage. From beginner‑friendly modes to intense challenges with aggressive enemy attacks, you can freely switch difficulties at any time. Play the story at the pace that suits you best.

◆Waves of Enemies Flood the Battlefield
Enemies appear one after another, and some stages unleash enough forces to completely fill the screen. Your decision‑making and preparation are the key to breaking through.

◆Story
The autonomous weapons that destroyed the world in a single night came to be known as “LIV.”
The survivors fled underground, leaving the surface as a lawless wasteland where supplies and rogue machines roamed freely.
Humanity’s last hope became the ARCS, enhanced humans long condemned for their inhumane origins.

You were supposed to be dead. But the military recovered your body, repaired it, reconditioned it, and sent you back into the battlefield.
Your past actions, your beliefs—everything was overwritten. What remains is a body built only to fight.
“The mission continues. As long as you draw breath.”

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4409620/ARCS
